name: Lead cost and friction planner
why: Works out cost per qualified lead with handling cost included, the number LinkedIn budgets should be judged on.

name: Lead offer tuner
why: Tunes the guide, demo or audit behind a Lead Gen Form to get more replies or fewer weak ones.

name: Weekly sales pipeline reviewer
why: Reads the deal export each week, so LinkedIn results are checked against real pipeline.

name: Stalled deal revival desk
why: Helps sales follow up LinkedIn leads that went quiet, with the next message to send.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: A monthly check that catches broken tags and double counts across ad platforms, including the Insight Tag.

name: Campaign link tracker
why: Builds tagged links and match rules so LinkedIn traffic shows up correctly in analytics and the CRM.

name: Incrementality test planner
why: Plans a test of what LinkedIn ads really add, sized to spend and regions.

name: Campaign fame checker
why: Checks a brand campaign plan for fame, useful for the out-of-market buyers LinkedIn brand spend aims at.

name: Channel budget mix planner
why: Plans how much of the ad budget LinkedIn should get against other channels.

name: Ad test budget calculator
why: Sets the spend needed before judging an ad test and a keep or cut rule.

name: Ad fatigue watcher
why: Spots ads whose results are slipping so a new concept is briefed in time.
